title: Office Snacks: The Safe Ones and the Ones That Quietly Add Weight
intro: Snacking at the office is not wrong. It can even help you overeat less at lunch or dinner. What quietly adds weight is usually not the type of snack, but how often and how much you eat without noticing.

sections.h: Snacks that are easy to overeat
sections.p: Chips, cream biscuits, sweet bread, chocolate and 3-in-1 drinks are tasty and easy to grab. One sachet of 3-in-1 drink is an estimated 100-150 kcal, and many people drink 2-3 a day. You can still have these snacks. They are just easy to overeat because they are not very filling.

Choose snacks with protein or fibre. For example, boiled eggs, fruit like apples, bananas or guava, plain yogurt, boiled corn, or wholemeal bread with egg. Nuts are good too, but a small handful of about 30 g is already an estimated 160-180 kcal.

sections.h: Out of sight, out of mouth
sections.p: If there is a biscuit jar on your desk, your hand will reach for it even when you are not hungry. Keep snacks in a drawer or the pantry. Put your water bottle and fruit where you can easily see them.

Sometimes we eat because we are stressed by emails, bored or sleepy. Before you grab a snack, ask yourself: if there was a boiled egg right now, would I eat it? If not, you may not be hungry. Try drinking water or taking a short walk.

action: Bring 1-2 planned snacks from home every workday this week.
Move sweet snacks from your desk into a drawer.
Portion nuts or biscuits into small containers instead of eating straight from a big pack.
Replace one 3-in-1 drink a day with kopi o or teh o with less sugar.
Refill your water bottle at least twice a day at the office.
myth: Many people believe healthy snacks can be eaten in any amount. In fact, nuts, granola or dates still have calories, so portions still matter even when the food is nutritious.

faq.q: Do I need to stop snacking completely?
faq.a: No need. Planned snacks can help you avoid getting too hungry and overeating later. The key is to choose filling types and know your portion.

faq.q: I love chocolate. What should I do?
faq.a: You can have it. Take one or two small pieces, eat slowly and enjoy it. It is better to eat a little mindfully than to hold back until you finish a whole bar.

faq.q: If I work OT until late, what snacks are suitable?
faq.a: Choose ones with protein like boiled eggs, yogurt, tofu or bread with egg. This helps you not be too hungry when you get home, so dinner is more controlled.
